create_job_config: create a JobConfig dataclass to configure a job with run name, device type, and scheduler settings
configure_slurm_config: configure a SlurmConfig dataclass to set memory, timeout, and CPU allocation for SLURM jobs
configure_scheduler_config: configure a SchedulerConfig dataclass to set scheduler mode, distributed init method, and node count
use_scheduler_type_enum: use the SchedulerType enum to select between local and SLURM scheduler modes for job execution
use_device_type_enum: use the DeviceType enum to select between CPU and CUDA device types for job execution
